prompt: Create a pixel-art sprite atlas for a Daggerfall Unity NPC portrait gaze layer, using the attached exact reference grid as the source of identity, palette, pixel style, framing, and eye anatomy. The output canvas must be exactly 1024x560 pixels, a 2-by-2 grid of four equal 512x280 cells (each cell aspect 64:35, equivalent to a 64x35 native portrait crop enlarged 8x). Cell order: top-left LEFT gaze, top-right RIGHT gaze, bottom-left LEFT gaze half-closed, bottom-right RIGHT gaze half-closed. Every cell is a complete upper portrait crop; preserve the same woman's face, hair and fringe, skin, brows, composition, lighting, and exterior pixels. Preserve the narrow original eye apertures and the current neutral brow shape exactly. Preserve the source compact small amber/olive irises, dark pupils, and muted tiny highlights. Make a subtle horizontal glance only, about one native pixel: in each gaze, BOTH colored irises and pupils must move together toward the same canvas side, coordinated and natural, so the person looks toward image-left in both left-gaze cells and toward image-right in both right-gaze cells. Keep both pupils inside their source eyelids and consistent in size and shape. Do not leave one pupil centered while the other moves. The lower row must show the source's half-closed eyelid aperture, not repeat open eyes; retain compact iris visibility naturally under the lids. Keep all pixel clusters crisp and irregularly stepped, with continuous lid contours. Preserve the source-like subdued glints only. No widened whites, broad white bands, enlarged eyes, round/vector irises, extra highlights, vertical or diagonal gaze, eyebrow movement, changed expression, hair/fringe edits, face redesign, blur, smoothing, antialiasing, text, borders, or added content. Match the exact reference grid proportions and cleanly aligned cell boundaries.
